claims.claim: Varonis has completed its SaaS transition and plans to end support for its legacy self-hosted product on December 31, 2026, concentrating the platform on autonomous data security outcomes.

risks.risk: The self-hosted end-of-life creates migration and retention execution risk for customers that have not moved to SaaS.

unknowns.unknown: This source does not quantify remaining self-hosted customer exposure or migration churn.

claims.claim: The December 31, 2026 self-hosted end-of-life is a concrete execution checkpoint for Varonis' all-SaaS strategy.

risks.risk: Execution quality depends on completing migrations without material customer disruption while legacy support is withdrawn.

unknowns.unknown: Current migration completion and renewal outcomes are not established by this source.
